cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine includes the baking time. Please leave that larger slice for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only before labor is included. Count the baking separately, then divide what's left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate the spare icing already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That was the taste test. Please keep testing out of the portion calculation; I still need the slice that includes my baking.
